briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies global AGI race amid Chinese model surges

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases as compute scaling continues. US-China tensions dominate funding and export controls. Safety concerns mount with production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic countered with Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind deployed Gemini 3, while Meta and xAI open-sourced large models this month.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits delays; Microsoft and Google announce new $50B+ data center clusters in Texas and Arizona. TSMC expands AI chip capacity.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-source models close the capability gap with closed frontier labs by end of 2027?
